passage.label: example those entrusted Torah then did not take it on like donkey carries volumes books; wretched example people deny signs Allah; Allah does not guide wrongdoing; say O Jews if claim allies Allah excluding other people wish death if truthful; but not wish ever because what hands put forth; Allah Knowing wrongdoers; say indeed death flee from indeed meet you; returned Knower unseen witnessed inform about what used do

arabicExcerpts.text: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ حُمِّلُواْ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَحۡمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡحِمَارِ يَحۡمِلُ أَسۡفَارَۢاۚ بِئۡسَ مَثَلُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوٓاْ إِن زَعَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُاْ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوۡنَهُۥٓ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَفِرُّونَ مِنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مُلَٰقِيكُمۡۖ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Those entrusted with the Torah who failed to carry it likened to a donkey bearing volumes of books — a wretched example for deniers of Allah's signs, whom He does not guide; the challenge to those claiming exclusive alliance with Allah to wish for death if truthful, knowing they never will because of what their hands have earned under His knowledge of wrongdoers; the declaration that the death they flee will inevitably meet them, after which they return to the Knower of unseen and witnessed who discloses their deeds

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Say: O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allah excluding other people, then wish for death if you should be truthful.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Entrusted with the Torah yet failing to carry it, likened to a burden-bearing donkey
Claiming exclusive alliance with Allah yet unable to wish for death due to earned deeds
Fleeing from a death that will inevitably meet them

relationships.label: Denial of Allah's signs earning the wretched-example verdict and withheld guidance
Return to the Knower of unseen and witnessed who discloses all past deeds

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the bounty declaration (4) before the Torah-donkey parable opens (5); P2 ends with the inevitable-death disclosure (8) before the Friday command begins (9); P3 covers the Jumu'ah obligation, post-prayer dispersal and the trade-diversion rebuke (9-11).
